content: Gaammota Ollan Daaneela Yegeteth
Kawo Daariyoosi ba kawoteththa ubbaa giddon baappe garsara biittaa haariza 120 daannata shuumanaas koyides.
Qasse kawozas aykkoyka paccontta mala, he biittaa haarizayta xeellana mala heedzdzu asata halaqa ooththidi doorides; doorettidaytappe issoy Daaneela.
Daaneeli hankko dere ayssizaytappenne daannatappe aadho erateththan kumidaade gidi beettida gishshas kawozi iza ba kawoteththaa bolla shuumanaas qoppides.

Hessafe guye hankko dereza ayssizaytinne daannati Daaneeli ooththiza kawo oosoza bolla kasase demmidi mootana koyida; gido attiin Daaneeli keehi bana naagizaade, ammanettidaadenne iza oosoza bolla wosoy baynda gishshas izappe mooro demmanaas dandaybeettenna.
Hessa gishshas istti ba garsan, «Nu Daaneela mootanaas koykko iza Xoossaa woga gaasonppe attiin hara ogera nu iza mootanaas ay moorokka demmanaas dandayokko» gida.
Hessafe guye dere ayssizaytinne daannati issi bolla kawozaakko biidi, «Kawo Daariyoosa! Neni mernaas kawota!

Nuni ne kawoteththa garsan deraa ayssanaas uttidayti kawoteththan dhoqqa shuumeti, mokkonneti, daannati, dereza ayssizaytinne zorizayti, nuni issife zore qachchida issi miishshi dees; hessika hachchife biidi heedzdzu tammu gallas gakkanaas ay asikka nenappe attiin hara ay xoossika woykko hara as woossontta mala ne awajja; hessa he awajjaa ooththonttaadey gaammota ollan yegettana mala ne azaza.
Hessa gishshas kawoo! Hayssi awajjazi Meedoonenne paarise woga mala laamettontta mino gidana mala neni iza bolla ne pirima woththa» gida.
Hessa gishshas Kawo Daariyoosi awajjoza xaafi paramidi kessides.

Daaneeli awajjazi paramettidi kezidayssa erida mala baso bides; pooqe bolla maskootey Yerusalaame bagga simmidi doyetti diza kifilezan kase woossizayssaththo gallas gallas heedzdzuto gulbatidi woossides; ba Xoossaaka galatides.
Heyti zuppetida asati issife biidi Daaneeli ba Xoossa woossishin demmida.

Ubbayka issife kawozaakko biidi, «Kawoo! Neni hayssafe kase biidi heedzdzu tammu gallas gakkanaas neeppe attiin asi hara ay xoossasikka woykko asaas hokki goynniza asi gaammota ollan yegettana mala awajja parama kessabeekkii?» gi oychchida. Kawozikka «Ee, Meedoonenne paarise woga mala laamettontta mino awajjay awajjettides» gides.
Isttika, «Kawoo! Histtiin hekko Yuhudappe di7etti yidaytappe issoy Daaneeli nenanne ne xaafa kessida awajjaza bonchchenna; izi ha7ikka gallas gallas heedzdzuto ba Xoossa woossees» gida.
Kawozikka hessa siyidi keehi ceecides; Daaneela ashshanaas qofa qachchides; arshey wullana gakkanaas iza ashshana oge medhdhanaas dafettides.
Asatikka issife kawozaakko biidi «Kawoo! Meedoonenne paarise wogan issi kawoy ba awajjida awajja woykko ba azazida azazo laammanaas dandayonttayssa ne era!» gida.
Hessa gishshas Daaneeli oyketti yiidi gaammota ollan yegettana mala kawozi azazides. Kawozikka Daaneela, «Neni ubba wode ammaneteththan izas goynniza ne GODAY nena ashsho» gides.
Ollaza doona shuchchara gordidi Daaneela bolla oosettoyssi laamettontta mala kawozi ba midiga maatameninne shuumeta midiga maatamen shocides.
Hessafe guye Kawozi gede baso kawo keeth simmides; kawokka mibeenna; iza ufayssiza miishshi izakko shiiqontta mala ixxidi dhiskoy baynda aqides.
Maalado wonttara buro bazzoy zo7ishin kawozi dendidi eeson gaammota ollaako bides.
Izi hee gakkida mala ceecishe, «De7o Xoossaa oosanchcha Daaneela! Neni izas ammaneteththan ooththiza ne Xoossay nena gaammotappe ashshanaas dandaydee?» giidi xeygides.
Daaneelikka izas, «Kawoo! Neni mernaas kawota!

Gaammoti tana qohontta mala Xoossi ba kiitanchcha taakko kiittidi istta doona gordides; izi hessaththo ooththiday tani iza achchan xillonne nenakka tani qohonttayssa izi eriza gishshassa» gi zaarides.
Kawozi keehi ufayettides; Daaneelakka gaammo olla giddofe kessana mala azazides. Daaneeli ba Xoossan ammanettida gishshas izi ollafe kezida wode iza bolla issi qohoykka gakkibeenna.

Hessafe guye kase Daaneela wordora mootida asati ba machchetara, ba naytara oyketti yiidi gaammota ollan yegettana mala kawozi azaziin gaammota ollan istta yeggida; istti ollaan duge gakkontta dishin gaammoti puuzi yeggidi istta meqeththata nififi histti menththereththida.
Hessafe guye kawo Daariyoosi alame bolla diza deraas, kawoteththatassinne dumma dumma qaalan haasayza as ubbaas hayssafe kaalliza kiitaa xaafi kiittides; «Saroy inttes gido!
Ta kawoteththan diza derey wurikka Daaneela Xoossas yayyana malanne
Hessa gishshas Daaneeli kawo Daariyoosa kawoteththa wodeninne Paarise dere as Qiroosa kawoteththa layth ubbaan izas de7oy injjetides.
